'''Bola Quo''' was a resident of [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Quo was interviewed by [[Nik Kigee]] of ''[[The Coruscant Holo Net]]'' after the planet was attacked by the bounty hunter [[Zatch (bounty hunter)|Zatch]] and a gang of Trandoshan mercenaries, and reported seeing Zatch's swoop bike "go down in a ball of flames" after coming under fire from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
